items.excerpt: China’s National Data Administration will improve standards on the measurement and billing of artificial intelligence tokens and quality assessment, as Beijing guides the development of the growing industry.

items.headline: Taiwan Widens Short Sale Curbs After Shares Plunge on AI Concern
items.excerpt: Taiwan widened curbs on short sales of local stocks and said it has been buying shares, stepping up efforts to revive confidence after the island’s benchmark index had its worst weekly fall in 35 years.

items.headline: China Deploys 5G Across Manufacturing Base as 6G Testing Advances, CCTV Reports
items.excerpt: China is expanding the use of 5G across its manufacturing sector, with more than 26,000 private industrial 5G networks built nationwide, China Central Television said on Saturday.

items.excerpt: On the heels of Anthropic PBC’s record-breaking initial public offering, a researcher at the company said he believes he used its artificial intelligence software to solve a famous number theory problem that has plagued mathematicians for more than 150 years.

items.excerpt: Grubhub owner Wonder is considering a sale of the food-delivery business, the Wall Street Journal reported, adding to a wave of dealmaking in the sector.

items.excerpt: Record demand for the hot new video game Grand Theft Auto VI sent US internet traffic soaring this week.

items.headline: Cognition in Talks for $75 Billion Value With New Funding
items.excerpt: Artificial intelligence coding startup Cognition AI Inc. is in funding talks at a $75 billion valuation, just two months after announcing its most recent funding round, according to people familiar with the matter.

items.headline: CrowdStrike Is in Talks to Buy Cybersecurity Firm Zscaler
items.excerpt: CrowdStrike Holdings Inc. is in talks to acquire Zscaler Inc., according to people familiar with the matter, in a deal that would be among the largest-ever in the cybersecurity sector.

items.headline: US Credit-Fear Hits 8-Month High as Tech Angst Roils Markets
items.excerpt: Measures of perceived US credit risk reached levels not seen in nearly eight months and the cost of protecting the debt of some of the biggest tech firms against default jumped on Friday, as the wobbling AI trade spurred volatility in global markets and sent investors piling into safe havens.

items.headline: Emerging Stocks Enter Bear Market as AI Triggers Global Selloff
items.excerpt: The MSCI emerging-market stock index entered a bear market Friday, declining for a seventh day, the longest losing streak since 2024, amid a selloff in global tech shares.
